correctness.rationale: For every N>=3, the differential equation for h(y)=arccos(y)^2 yields positive Taylor coefficients in 1-y with c_N=2^{N+1}/(N² C(2N,N)). The Nth derivative sign and Hermite interpolation on prescribed Chebyshev nodes produce a globally nonnegative remainder with exact coefficient. Character cancellations eliminate the polynomial. Concentration follows from sine chord bounds, and recovery of N discrete masses from the first N-1 modes gives explicit W1. Opposite translates have deficit h² and W1 h, proving sharp rate. Endpoint limits and all quantifiers checked; finite diagnostics supplemental.

value.rationale: The problem has a natural analytic object (positive measure with N-1 vanished Fourier modes), precise geometric invariant (squared angular cost), unique regular-quadrature optimizer and a motivated robust recovery question. The result combines a nonnegative global deficit witness with recovery of masses and an optimal-rate lower witness; unlike an arbitrary numeric slice it yields a structural all-N theorem and an application to repeated characteristic-function zeros.
